scope: Reviewed regression contract for NY-7.RP.2 only, sourced from archived NYSED full mathematics PDF page 90. Changing this contract requires source review; it is not a general semantic oracle.

wc:expectation:decide-proportional.object: whether two quantities are in a proportional relationship

qualifiers: in verbal descriptions of proportional relationships

wc:expectation:explain-proportional-poin.object: what a point (x, y) on the graph of a proportional relationship means

wc:annotation:7-rp-2-modeling.original_text: Proportional relationships (NY-7.RP.2 & 3) present opportunities for modeling (MP.4).
wc:annotation:7-rp-2-modeling.interpretation: A shared opportunity note for standards 2 and 3; no separate MP.4 or prerequisite edge is asserted.
wc:annotation:7-rp-2-modeling.source_locator: PDF/printed page 90; Connecting the Standards for Mathematical Practice to Mathematical Content

wc:annotation:7-rp-2a-strategies.original_text: Strategies include but are not limited to the following: testing for equivalent ratios in a table and/or graphing on a coordinate plane and observing whether the graph is a straight line through the origin.
wc:annotation:7-rp-2a-strategies.interpretation: Non-exhaustive strategies; does not require both strategies on every task.

wc:annotation:7-rp-2c-example.original_text: If total cost t is proportional to the number n of items purchased at a constant price p, the relationship between the total cost and the number of items can be expressed as t = pn.
wc:annotation:7-rp-2c-example.interpretation: Illustrative cost equation; t, p, and n are example variables, not mandated names for every task.
